content: Classic PHP-on-IIS has no persistent worker process; sync jobs are run via Windows Task Scheduler invoking php.exe (php-cli) with the sync script as an argument, decoupled from the IIS/FastCGI web request. Admin panel writes a 'sync requested' flag/row and the scheduled task (or a CLI script triggered via exec/proc_open with output redirected, run detached) executes it; alternatively admin trigger can shell out to php.exe directly in the background (non-blocking exec) for near-immediate sync without needing OS-level scheduling.
